digest.component_or_area: rebar write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) + close precheck gate
propositions: A retroactive commit-linking repair surface (attach-commits verb) must be exposed on all three surfaces: CLI, library (rebar.attach_commits), and MCP with identical all-or-nothing SHA validation in the seam.

The close precheck gate must deterministically block when linked commits' file diffs contain paths not declared in file_impact or exemption globs, naming offending paths and directing users to rebar set-file-impact.

A shared DET module commit_impact.py provides SHA validation (git rev-parse), **/- aware glob matching (hoisted from prompts.py and registry.py), and path matchers without importing rebar.llm, with both legacy glob_match calls delegating to it.

Commit discovery unions two sources: state.commits from COMMITS events and local commits reachable from HEAD with rebar-ticket: trailer or <id>: subject prefix, applied over the same transitive descendant id set (not just the ticket itself).

Merge commits are explicitly skipped from path inspection; source-(ii) local commits fail closed on git errors, while source-(i) fetched commits are skipped if absent locally, asymmetrically preventing false-positives on shared repos.
The close gate is wired into close_precheck.py with _referencing_commits refactored to return SHAs while _referencing_commit_exists retains its bool contract as a thin wrapper.
